title: House approves P27.9B Congress budget for 2027 without questions

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives on Thursday terminated sponsorship and plenary deliberations on the proposed P27.89-billion budget for the Congress of the Philippines for 2027 without any interpellation.
